rootCause: The deterministic next-criterion matcher recognized maintain/compare/check verbs but omitted the short targeted imperatives assigned to pass_angle, including 세워봐 and 고정해.

implementation.behavior: A future or ordering cue followed by an explicit particle-marked target and a narrow safe set of concrete planning verbs is accepted. Generic 하다/잘하다 and discard/quit verbs are not accepted by the new branch.

attempts.matchedCriterionSentence: 오늘 비교할 건 새 문제 양과 틀린 유형 반복이야.
firstThreeVisibleSentences: 연습 점수가 목표 수준이고 객관식이라, 전날 책상 기준은 새 프린트보다 반복 실수 차단이야.
계산값의 신금(辛金, 잘라내고 고르는 금속의 상징)은 넓히기보다 버리는 기준으로 읽어봐.

decision: The next-criterion slice passes its representative captured and new actual-output checks. ZIP-003-041 remains IN_PROGRESS because all-service semantic acceptance is not complete.

applied: Removed discard/quit verbs from the new matcher branch and added unsafe 시험을 버려/공부를 끊어 counterexamples.
Added source-native 버릴 공부를 정해/남길 공부 순서를 매겨 positive fixtures.
minorApplied: Attempt evidence parsing accepts fenced or surrounded JSON and reports invalid input instead of crashing.

limitations: The new provider section is not overall complete; its second attempt still failed the separate grounding recognizer.
Only pass_angle representative output was evaluated in this slice.
Raw provider output stays in ignored isolated cache; tracked hashes and three visible synthetic sentences preserve audit evidence.
